items: Bactericidal asar: yeh DNA replication wale enzymes ko DNA ke saath aik complex mein phansa deti hain jo DNA ke dono strands tor deta hai (double-strand break). Is se bacteria afzaish nahi kar pate aur mar jate hain; is liye yeh bactericidal (bacteria maarne wali) hain.
Topoisomerases ko nishana banana: yeh bacterial cell mein dakhil ho kar Type II topoisomerases (DNA ko kholne aur alag karne wale enzymes) ko rok deti hain.
Topoisomerase IV: Gram-positive bacteria mein yeh zyada tar is enzyme ko nishana banati hain; is se replicate shuda DNA ki do copies alag nahi ho patin.
DNA gyrase: Gram-negative bacteria mein yeh zyada tar DNA gyrase ko nishana banati hain; is se replication ke dauran DNA ka khulna (uncoiling) ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Gram-negative bacteria mein fluoroquinolones zyada tar kis enzyme ko nishana banati hain?
blocks.explanation: DNA gyrase ko, jo replication ke dauran DNA kholta hai (Gram-positive mein zyada tar topoisomerase IV).

items: Fluoroquinolones: synthetic, bactericidal; quinine/chloroquine ki tayyari se nikle.
Type II topoisomerases rokti hain: DNA gyrase (Gram-negative), topoisomerase IV (Gram-positive); DNA tootne se bacteria marte hain.
